svg.title: How the app works
svg.desc: How the app works. 1. Pick an option: A numbered terminal menu. The interface text is in Portuguese. 2. Validate input: Non-numeric, out-of-range and blank answers are asked again. 3. Store safely: Parameterized SQL in a local SQLite file; older schemas upgrade on startup. 4. Report: Totals, averages and Matplotlib charts, even for an empty database.
